notes.title: New Content: Advanced Technology
notes.notes:
This [b]major content update[/b] brings:

[list]
[*]The [b]Advanced Technology[/b] wing - a sixth section with [b]twelve new levels[/b] introducing the new mechanics, including some extremely difficult ones.
[*][b]New mechanic: Traps[/b] - Blocking the pawns that move on them until they teleport away.
[*][b]New mechanic: Bridges[/b] - Vertical or horizontal, they only allow pawns to pass in one direction... but they can push other pawns through the walls!
[*][b]New mechanic: Blocker Goals[/b] - An advanced technology which let us make tests more compact by giving color to goals themselves!
[*][b]New mechanic: Double Goals[/b] - Yet another madness from our goals departement, a cell that needs two passes to validate.
[/list]

[b]What crazy levels will you invent with this new tech?[/b]

Share your creations on [b]Minimal Crypt[/b]'s Discord, and play tenths of additional levels made by the game developers and by the community!

notes.title: 2021/10/05 - Bug fixes update
notes.notes:
[b]2021/10/05 - Changelog[/b]

→ Added a display of current level number and section name in the campaign.
→ Corrected a bug with the AI not exploring all the level states containing Catchers (tile exclusive to the Editor).
→ Corrected a bug with Undo in the Editor where you could go back to previous levels and put the game in an illegal state.
→ Corrected a minor bug with the search field in the Editor receiving input while playing the level.
